description:
Download TikTok videos, hashtags and whole accounts.


- Videos downloading without audio fixed. Videos downloaded through the app now correctly include audio, with further quality improvements planned for an upcoming release.
- Crash during subscription updates fixed. We resolved a crash that could occur while subscriptions were updating. Updates should now run smoothly without the app unexpectedly closing.
- “Edit” menu item fixed. The Edit tab now works correctly when you have downloaded content. Previously, it appeared, but nothing in it could be clicked.
- Control Panel auto-close improved. The Control Panel now closes automatically after clicking “Download My Account”, “Download My Favorites”, and “Download My Likes”.
- Black bars on window resize fixed. Resizing the app window no longer leaves black bars on screen.
- Various other UI/UX and stability improvements added.
